Market today: Mixed signals for tech. Big tech is pushing AI, but Musk's comments are hitting AI/Neocloud names. This creates volatility, especially for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Several leveraged positions are deep in the red, amplifying losses on margin. SOXL is down -62.1%, MUU -34.12%, and SPAL -39.24%. These need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on broader market sentiment around AI, as conflicting news from Meta and Musk could drive sector volatility. Also, review stops on your deeply negative leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: Volatility in AI and chips demands tight risk management on your most exposed positions.
plays: Review stops on SOXL, MUU, SPAL, and SMCI. These leveraged/concentrated positions are significantly down; margin amplifies drops.
Consider trimming SPY (up 3.84%) to reduce overall market exposure and free up margin amidst tech uncertainty.
No new buys today - hold and watch. While ZS and TXN are on scanner, no strong external catalyst to act now.
